findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy Header
findings.evidence: Content-Security-Policy header not present in response
findings.impact: Increased risk of XSS, data injection, and clickjacking attacks
findings.remediation: Add CSP header: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline';

findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security Header
findings.impact: HTTPS not enforced, vulnerable to SSL stripping attacks
findings.remediation: Add HSTS header: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header
findings.impact: Vulnerable to clickjacking attacks
findings.remediation: Add X-Frame-Options: DENY or SAMEORIGIN

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options Header
findings.impact: MIME type sniffing may lead to XSS
findings.remediation: Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy Header
findings.impact: Full referrer sent with cross-origin requests, potential information leakage
findings.remediation: Add Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy Header
findings.impact: No control over browser features/APIs available to page
findings.remediation: Add Permissions-Policy with appropriate restrictions

findings.title: Version Disclosure via Server Header
findings.impact: Attacker can fingerprint server/framework versions for targeted exploits
findings.remediation: Remove or obfuscate Server header

findings.title: Exposed Version Control Directory: /.gitignore
findings.impact: Source code disclosure, history exposure, potential secret leakage
findings.remediation: Block access to /.gitignore via web server config; remove from web root
